Partial and downstream-evidence-gated merges remain non-terminal.

The existing post-merge workflow observes closure drift without checkout, direct-main mutation, approval, auto-merge or merge authority.

Exact-head required checks pass before Human/CODEOWNER merge.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
